definitions.explanation: Meat intended for human consumption, as distinguished from live animals or non-food uses.

examples.japanese: {食肉|しょくにく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がった→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: The price of meat has gone up.

examples.japanese: {食肉|しょくにく}⟦{加工|かこう}→加工：11793_kakou⟧⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}いている→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: I work at a meat processing plant.

examples.japanese: {食肉|しょくにく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{安全性|あんぜんせい}→安全性：19384_anzensei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{関|かん}する→関する：02045_kansuru⟧⟦{規制|きせい}→規制：02598_kisei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強化|きょうか}→強化：00260_kyouka⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Regulations on meat safety have been strengthened.

examples.japanese: ⟦{国産|こくさん}→国産：12017_kokusan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{食肉|しょくにく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{品質|ひんしつ}→品質：09507_hinshitsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: Domestically produced meat is said to be high quality.

notes:
{食|しょく} (eating, food) + ⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧ (meat, flesh). A formal or industry term for meat as a food product. Used more in official, commercial, or regulatory contexts than in everyday cooking talk.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {食肉|しょくにく}⟦{加工|かこう}→加工：11793_kakou⟧: meat processing
- {食肉|しょくにく}⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧: meat market (wholesale)
- {食肉|しょくにく}⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧: meat inspection
- {食肉|しょくにく}⟦{業界|ぎょうかい}→業界：13129_gyoukai⟧: meat industry
- {食肉|しょくにく}{店|てん}: butcher shop

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧: meat — the everyday word used in cooking and daily life
- ⟦{精肉|せいにく}→精肉：14826_seiniku⟧: dressed meat — meat that has been trimmed and prepared for retail sale
- {鮮肉|せんにく}: fresh meat — emphasizes freshness

USAGE:
In daily conversation, people say ⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧ rather than {食肉|しょくにく}. {食肉|しょくにく} appears in news articles about food safety, industry reports, and official regulations. The compound also appears in {食肉|しょくにく}{目|もく} (Carnivora, the order of carnivorous mammals), though this is a biological classification term.
